notes.title: Japanese Localization is Here! + Spring Sale 2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I'm excited to announce that Kingdom Shell now supports Japanese! If you've been waiting to experience the game in Japanese, now is the perfect time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35838881/033599703b608e70e69f231247b1ec952d255a7e.gif

And that's not all — Kingdom Shell is currently on sale as part of Steam's Spring Sale 2025! If you haven't had a chance to dive into the world of the Kingdom yet, now is a great time to do so.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35838881/a1c11d0dda91a9cb5703a0bcf3c2d6459b0ce6fc.gif

What's new in the update?
✔ Full Japanese localization – now even more players can enjoy the story of the Kingdom.
✔ Optimizations and fixes – small improvements for an even smoother gameplay experience.

Thank you for your support, and I hope you enjoy the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1154090/Kingdom_Shell/

notes.title: Small update: Version 1.013
notes.content:
Hello to all residents of the Kingdom.

In this update, I've added the option to skip the shoot'em up section. After a few unsuccessful attempts, Hermes will suggest the player dispel the illusion.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35838881/eca98e6b0b04257d70341dae3a824025cc9d0402.png

I initially introduced the shoot'em up section to diversify gameplay and provide players with a break from platforming. However, I've noticed that some players are having difficulties with this level, and others simply don't enjoy this genre. Therefore, I've added the option to choose. After all, Kingdom Shell is a metroidvania.

notes.title: Update: Version 1.010 – Spanich localization
notes.content:
This is not a small update:

- Spanish language added. It was a challenging task as there were queries to the translators. Apologies for the delay in localization; I hope the translation is of high quality (players will provide feedback:)

- Added the ability to toggle V-Sync in the settings. I hope this helps players who have experienced FPS drop issues.

- Minor fixes and visual changes.

notes.title: Small update: Version 1.009
notes.content:
Hey, everyone.

Finally I corrected a butterfly jumps mechanic. Hope now it feels much better and clear

My next task is to add additional languages, as well as solve the problem with the FPS drop for some users.

notes.title: Small update: Version 1.008
notes.content:
- Added camera control (if anything goes wrong, please don't hesitate to report).
- Leopold will be waiting for you in the forest hut after defeating all 3 sovereigns.
- Added low health indicator.

notes.title: Small update: Version 1.007
notes.content:
- Increased the time between the attack warning and the actual attack for the Lurker boss (Bulldozer in the Caves).
- Made Top City and Royal Palace more player-friendly, thus balancing the difficulty curve.
- Reduced the duration of negative status effects, such as blindness and dizziness.
- The "Sustainability" inspiration now decreases damage from many traps, not just pits and spikes.

notes.title: Small update: Version 1.006
notes.content: - Updated the puzzle-key. Now, when the segment is in the correct position, it flickers, vibrates and makes a sound.

notes.title: Dev update #1
notes.content:
One and half of a week has passed since the Kingdom Shell demo starting. First of all I want to say a huge thank to everyone who played the demo and gives me a feedback. It's really very important to me, because it helps me to improve Kingdom Shell. And here are some improves of the game.
Map
Map has changed a little. Now you can see a name of the current location. I redrew marks of Mnemona's tower and shops on the map. Now there is an opportunity to scale the map.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35838881/f8a2bf99446218b46028da29fa43032960fd8994.gif
Dualshock
Finally added Dualshock and it works perfectly:)

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35838881/fa471185b211618be57a5e02f1a3f8712e85fe78.png
Respawn of an enemies
An enemies don't respawn after you leave a room.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35838881/15cd37e604b839fe114622a91d0f033d5a8cea37.gif
The very first difficult enemy
Remade a Marauder, a man in a red hood. I redrew his sprite, reduced his hp, and changed his behavior a little.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35838881/006cd08063a36b4629d14aa2bae749ac1b1c7220.gif

[hr][/hr]
That's all for today, but work on Kingdom Shell continues. Every day I do my best to make the game better.
If you want to give me a feedback or some ideas I'll appreciate it.
[hr][/hr]
And I'll be very happy if you add Kingdom Shell to your wishlist
